UI assets from dawsu! Studio V3.1.4, commit c81774e of the C# editor.
The app mark comes from OsuHitsound.App/Assets/dawsu-256.png and dawsu.ico.
The copied SVGs come from Assets/StudioIcons. Drumstick, TrendingUp, Pause and House
are the original Icons.axaml paths wrapped as SVG. The bundled fonts come
from Assets/Fonts and retain their SIL Open Font License texts under fonts/.

Icons
  Icons.axaml holds Lucide icons (v0.469.0) converted to stroke geometry: the tools,
  transport, window and start screen icons.
  Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
